name: Picked bass
credit: Black And Blue Basses — Karoryfer Samples
_what: The blue solidbody, played with a pick. The same library and the same
octave correction as the fingered bass — see bass_fingered.json — and
the `reg` maps rather than the `fake_det` and `fake_ntp` ones, which
are a detuned and a no-tone-pot variant of the same performances and
are a colour rather than a dynamic.
TWO DYNAMICS, AND WHY THE BANK SAYS TWO. Karoryfer recorded this bass
at f and ff only, where the black one has p, mp, mf and f. The bank
therefore declares two layers, and the engine's `voice_layer` does the
filling: it asks for layer 1, 2 or 3 by the line's gain and clamps to
the layers the bank has, so a soft line plays f and anything from
normal upwards plays ff. That is 'the nearest layer present', which is
what a third layer would have been — without shipping a copy of a file
and a third more memory to hold it.
Eight round robins in the source, which is four more than the black
bass and six more than a bank can carry.
_notes: The fingered bass's grid, for the reasons in that recipe: a fifth
apart, nothing further than two semitones from a sample, E2 among them.
Two layers rather than three leaves room for two more notes inside the
same 4-8 MB, so this bank samples eight and its worst stretch is one
semitone — the densest of the three basses, because it is the one whose
_release: file both basses in this library share.
